title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE TEK RRUGA KAVAJES
description_sq: Ofrohet per shitje nje apartament 2+1 i cili eshte i pozicionuar ne katin e 10 te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor. Eshte i organizuar ne nje soxhorno te bollshme ku ambjenti i gatimit eshte i vecuar, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe dy ballkone. Godina ku ndodhet apartamenti eshte e nje standarti te larte ndertimi, e miradministruar dhe e survejuar me kamera 24 ore. Orientimi eshte perendim dhe apartamenti te ofron nje pamje te lire. Zona ku ndodhet eshte prane qendres te qytetit,dhe e aksesueshme me unazen e vogel. Gjithashtu ju ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode,shkolla,markete,farmaci bare ,qender spitalore etj. Ofrohohet totalisht i mobiluar si ne foto. Disponon kontrate porosie .Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT RUGA KAVAJES
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, which is located on the 10th floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized in a spacious living room where the cooking area is separate, two bedrooms, two toilets and two balconies. The building where the apartment is located is of a high construction standard, well-managed and monitored with 24-hour cameras. Orientation is west and the apartment offers a free view. The area where it is located is near the city center, and accessible by the small ring road. It also offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, schools, markets, pharmacies, bars, hospital centers, etc. It is offered fully furnished as in the photo. Order contract is available. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
